_comment: Quorum configuration for dep-trust-check.yml override votes.
_doc: Add Discord user IDs to 'members'. Find a user ID: Discord → Settings → Advanced → Developer Mode ON, then right-click any user → Copy User ID.
_threshold_note: Fraction of quorum required for approval. 0.5 = strict simple majority (>50%). E.g. for 3 members: 2 votes needed. For 5 members: 3 votes needed.
_deadlineHours_note: Hours before an unresolved vote is closed and treated as DENIED (fail-closed).

_env_overrides.note: Any field here can be overridden at runtime via environment variables.
_env_overrides.QUORUM_MEMBERS: Comma-separated Discord user IDs — overrides members array
